title: Apply camera exposure compensation to fresh and reset RAW edits
notes: New/reset recipes persist a separate camera compensation marker: explicit DNG baseline metadata, including zero, takes precedence; otherwise Sony A7C II and A7R V receive +0.35 EV. Existing recipes retain their original baseline path. Saved/imported exposure values, before views, LUT previews and legacy NIND development retain their selected policy, including pending editor changes and virtual copies. Default render changes require maintainer review.
